first_check: Compare station pressure with a co-located calibrated reference before changing any setting.
tasks: 0-10 min: inspect replacement board, units, vent and configuration.
10-40 min: compare simultaneous readings with a calibrated portable reference; record the offset and stability.
40-60 min: verify the board calibration procedure, record serial/configuration and capture before/after readings; change calibration only with documented support.
reason: S02 has a measured persistent pressure discontinuity and stronger independent comparison evidence. S07 wind scaling is a serious alternative, but station-to-station wind differences make that diagnosis less certain. Bring a calibrated pressure reference; if unavailable, arrange it before visiting.
cautions: S04 temperature/rain and S07 wind remain investigation priorities; a screened cell is not proof that those instruments are calibrated.
